title: ChatGPT now knows what you do on other websites via ad collector
why_read: Raises a concrete privacy concern about how ChatGPT's ad-related data collection might link browsing behavior to AI conversations.
analysis: This HN item discusses a discovery that ChatGPT can apparently access information about a user's activity on other websites through some ad-tracking-adjacent mechanism, which is a significant privacy story if accurate. The technical details matter a lot here (what exactly is being collected, via what pipe, and whether it is opt-in) but aren't given in the title alone. Given the popularity and comment volume, this likely sparked serious debate about data flows between OpenAI and third-party ad networks. Engineers building products atop LLM APIs or worried about telemetry leakage should find this relevant.
